title: Cod in Indian Creamy Sauce
description: A delicate and flavorful Indian-inspired cod dish, made with a creamy garlic sauce. Perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Heat ghee or oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add cod fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Add creamy soup, chopped cod, garam masala, cumin powder, salt, and black pepper.
Stir well to combine and let simmer for 5-7 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Serve the cod in the creamy sauce hot, garnished with chopped cilantro or scallions.
Serve with steamed basmati rice or naan bread for a complete meal.
